name: Kedar
overview: Kedar is a male figure known as the second-born son of Ishmael, belonging to the tribe named after him. His identity is primarily grounded in his lineage as recorded in Genesis 25:13. There are no additional notes expanding on his life or deeds.
namesAndTitles: The name Kedar is a proper name that means 'mighty.' This meaning reflects a characteristic attributed to him through his name, as noted in Genesis 25:13. The name was not given by God but is significant in identifying his tribal lineage.
familyAndRelationships: Kedar is explicitly identified as a son of Ishmael, establishing his direct familial relationship. Beyond this, Scripture does not record further family relationships for him.
scriptureSignificance: Kedar holds significance in the biblical narrative as a direct descendant of Ishmael, Abraham's son, situating him within the broader story of God's covenant family. His position as the second-born son highlights the continuation of Ishmael's line, which is foundational to the existence of the tribe bearing his name. This connection underscores the fulfillment of God's promises through Abraham's descendants.
